blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — A police officer and members of the Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team (BPAT), who were conductingalaw enforcement patrol in Luwalhati Village, Barangay Suarez, here, were nearly hit by two passingvehiclesearly Thursday. The incident prompted a chase that ended with the interception of thevehicles andthe discovery and eventual seizure of a haul of contraband cigarettes. A police report said the chase lasted nearly a kilometer before the two vehicles were interceptedinBarangay Maria Cristina.
